entry.title: Warm And Sunny Monday Ahead For Roseburg, With Rain Chances Returning Later This Week
entry.summary: Roseburg will see a warm, sunny Monday with a high near 79 before cooler temperatures and increasing rain chances return later this week. The forecast stays mild Tuesday and Wednesday, with a wetter spring pattern expected by Thursday and into the weekend.
